translate_en|mods/Helicopter Event Expan: There's dangerous activity overhead... I should get under cover.
That air doesn't feel right... I should cover up and find shelter.
That transmission doesn't sound right... I should stay alert.
That sounded like something went down... I should stay away from the impact area.
It's getting closer... I need cover now!
It's moving away... for now.
The flashes have stopped... my vision should clear soon.
An approaching helicopter... I should find cover before its flashes reach me.
Something is happening out there... I should stay alert.
Something is disrupting everything... I can't rely on electronics right now.
Something keeps circling the area... I shouldn't remain exposed.
The helicopter flights have stopped... I don't think they're coming back.
The helicopter is leaving... the dead may start coming back.
That helicopter is approaching... it may drive the dead away from me.
They're operating nearby... I should secure what supplies I have.
The gas is clearing... I should recover my strength soon.
That helicopter is approaching with gas... I should get indoors.
A thick cloud is moving in... I need shelter and a clear way out.
That buzzing is scanning the area... I should turn on my long-range radio.
Adjusts local playback volume for HTT event sounds. Does not change zombie attraction noise.
Event Audio
Effect volume (%)
Additional client-local volume control for explosions, weapons, voices, scans, and other event effects.
Master event volume (%)
Master client-local volume. 100% uses the new half-volume baseline and multiplies the rotor and effect controls.
HTT Client
Rotor and flyby volume (%)
Additional client-local volume control for rotors, flybys, and helicopter presence tracks.

PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING
Helicopter Event Expansion Framework includes bright flashes
and sudden changes in screen brightness.
These effects may trigger seizures in people
with photosensitive epilepsy.
You can disable flash events in the sandbox settings.

There's dangerous activity overhead... I should get under cover.
That air doesn't feel right... I should cover up and find shelter.
The impacts have stopped... any fires they left behind may still be dangerous.
I can hear markers and distant impacts... nearby areas are being hit; I need to avoid the explosions and fire.
That transmission doesn't sound right... I should stay alert.
The transmission ended... the noise and the dead it drew may remain.
That voice from the air is drawing attention across the area... the noise may bring more of the dead.
That sounded like something went down... I should stay away from the impact area.
I can't hear any more air activity... the impact site will keep drawing trouble.
Something large just went down... that crash will draw the dead toward the impact area.
It's getting closer... I need cover now!
It's moving away... for now.
The flashes have stopped... my vision should clear soon.
An approaching helicopter... I should find cover before its flashes reach me.
The operation is over... I should check how much fuel remains in the nearby pumps.
That helicopter is operating over the gas stations... the pumps may not keep all their fuel.
Something is happening out there... I should stay alert.
They're firing at me now! I need to break their line of sight and find solid cover.
It's finally moving away... it seems to have stopped hunting me.
That helicopter is tracking my movements... if it opens fire, a roof and solid walls will be my best option.
The incendiary pass is over... but the fires it left may keep spreading.
That flight is leaving pockets of fire behind... I need to stay away from the smoke and anything that starts burning.
Something is disrupting everything... I can't rely on electronics right now.
The interference is fading... the equipment should begin responding again.
That pulse disrupted the equipment... lights, radios, and watches may fail until it passes.
Something keeps circling the area... I shouldn't remain exposed.
The helicopter flights have stopped... I don't think they're coming back.
The helicopter is leaving... the dead may start coming back.
That helicopter is approaching... it may drive the dead away from me.
They're operating nearby... I should secure what supplies I have.
The gas is clearing... I should recover my strength soon.
That helicopter is approaching with gas... I should get indoors.
A thick cloud is moving in... I need shelter and a clear way out.
They're no longer deploying smoke... the cloud will still take time to clear.
They're deploying a smoke screen... visibility will drop; I need to remember a clear route out.
The precise shots have stopped... the path should be a little clearer now.
Those isolated shots are dropping nearby zombies... someone seems to be clearing a path for me.
The supporting bursts are moving away... at least they should have thinned the zombies around me.
Those bursts are coming from the air and dropping zombies near me... they don't seem to be firing at survivors.
It stopped circling... I hope it lost my trail.
That aircraft isn't just passing by... it's watching the area and seems to be following my movements.
The cloud is here... I need to stay indoors and keep my breathing covered.
The cloud is starting to disperse... I'll wait indoors a little longer before breathing easy.
That helicopter is releasing something... the air is about to turn dangerous; I need a sealed interior and breathing protection.
The buzzing is moving away... it looks like the sweep of this area is over.
That buzzing is scanning the area... I should turn on my long-range radio.
The attack on the vehicle is over... they probably left it disabled.
Those bursts are aimed at a nearby military vehicle, not me... I should avoid getting close while the attack continues.

Balance Preset
Casual
Hardcore
Normal
Casual
Normal
Hardcore
Quickly applies a tuned set of values for toxic and attack events.
Event Duration Hours
Default duration in game hours when HTT starts an event.
Disable Events During Sleep
When enabled, automatic event starts and toxic ambient loops are paused while players are sleeping or time is fast-forwarded.
Enable Air Bombardment
Allows the air bombardment helicopter event to run.
Character Event Hints
When enabled, each player's character gives brief, ambiguous warnings and survival suggestions as synchronized events develop. The active event is never named directly.
Enable Downed Heli
Allows the downed helicopter crash event to run.
Enable EMI interference
Allows the electromagnetic interference (EMI) event to run.
Enable flash helicopter
Flashes every 12 seconds briefly whiten the vision of players outdoors within range. Interiors protect against new flashes.
Enable fuel reclamation
Allows the fuel reclamation helicopter event to run.
Enable Hostile Attack
Allows the hostile helicopter event to run.
Enable incendiary sweep
Allows the incendiary sweep event to run.
Enable military vehicle strike
Allows the military vehicle strike helicopter event to run.
Enable propaganda broadcast
Allows the propaganda broadcast event to run.
Enable sleep gas helicopter
Purple gas causes intense drowsiness and temporary endurance loss outdoors. Players recover the gas effect on leaving the cloud. Does not force sleep.
Enable smoke curtain event
Allows the smoke curtain event to run.
Enable sniper cover event
Allows the sniper cover event to run.
Enable Support Attack
Allows the support attack helicopter event to run.
Enable surveillance event
Allows the surveillance event to run.
Enable Toxic Event
Allows the toxic helicopter event to run.
Enable UAV zombie scan
Allows the UAV scan event to run and broadcast zombie density reports by radio.
Enable zombie repellent helicopter
A helicopter drives nearby zombies away from its followed player.
Fixed Daily Event Hour
When enabled, automatic HTT events ignore cooldowns and try to start once every in-game day at the fixed hour below.
Gradual and Permanent Event Cessation
Gradually increases intervals and lowers event probability until one final event occurs and helicopter events stop permanently.
Enable Incendiary Player Risk
If enabled, incendiary sweeps can land in a reduced but still safe range near players; players are never directly targeted.
Enable HTT Mod
Master switch for this mod. If disabled, HTT will not start events.
Random Cooldown Up To Max
When enabled, each vanilla-triggered HTT event uses a random cooldown between 6 hours and the value configured in Time Between Events.
Enable Vanilla Helicopter Hook
When enabled, a vanilla helicopter activation can trigger one HTT event while the vanilla helicopter keeps running.
Event Cessation Period
2-4 weeks
4-6 weeks
1-2 months
2-4 months
6 months-1 year
The server rolls and persists a cessation date within the selected period.
Time Between Events
In-game hours between vanilla-triggered HTT events. Valid range: 6 to 168. If random cooldown is enabled, this value becomes the upper bound of the random range.
Event Weight Hostile Attack
Relative chance weight for the hostile helicopter attack event.
Event Weight Support Attack
Relative chance weight for the support attack event.
Event Weight Toxic
Relative chance weight for the toxic event.
Zombie Attraction Sound Radius (%%)

Multiplies the tile radius of event sounds that attract zombies. 100 keeps the original range; 500 gives five times the range and is the default. Range: 0-500. 50 halves it and 0 disables this attraction. Audible volume is unchanged.
Daily Event Hour
In-game hour used by the fixed daily scheduler. Example: 9.50 = 09:30.
Flash whiteout duration
Seconds of temporary white vision, including the gradual fade. Worn sunglasses halve this duration.
Flash radius
Outdoor flash exposure radius in tiles.
Fuel Reclamation Drain (%%)
Fuel percentage drained from loaded gas pumps when the fuel reclamation helicopter completes extraction.
Helicopter Events
Hostile Burst Accuracy (%%)
Chance that a hostile burst lands a hit. Rolled once per burst.
Military Strike Chance (%%)
Chance that the military vehicle strike event will execute the attack when a valid military vehicle is found.
Zombie repellent radius
Radius in tiles around the followed player. Only loaded zombies can be redirected.
Sleep gas radius

Outdoor gas exposure radius in tiles. Indoors and leaving this radius allow recovery. Masks slow fatigue and endurance loss; filters wear 25% faster than the base toxic gas rate, with the same per-event limit.
Toxic Damage Curve Power
Damage curve exponent: higher values are gentler at low exposure and harsher near max.
Toxic Min Damage/Min
Minimum per-minute toxic player damage once exposure passes the damage threshold.
Toxic Damage/Min at Full Exposure
Base player health damage per minute when toxic exposure is at 100%%.
Toxic Zombie Damage Per Tick
Legacy zombie toxic damage per tick. Player toxic damage uses the per-minute options below.
Toxic Damage Preset
Hardcore
Medium
Soft
Soft
Medium
Hardcore
Applies preset toxic damage/exposure and tick pacing values for quick balancing.
Toxic Event Duration Hours
Duration in game hours used by toxic helicopter events. Other events still use Event Duration Hours.
Toxic Exposure Gain/Min
How fast toxic exposure builds per minute while unprotected.
Toxic Extra Damage/Min (Max)
Small extra per-minute damage when exposure is very high (>= 90%%).
Max Filter Wear per Event (%%)
Wear limit for the same filter during one toxic event. The default prevents one new filter from being exhausted by a single event.
Filter Wear per Hour (%%)
Percentage of a full gas-mask filter or air tank consumed per hour of direct gas exposure.
Toxic gas radius
Toxic gas exposure radius in tiles. Range: 10-100; default: 18. Applies to players and zombies.
Minimum Health with Respiratory Protection
Toxic gas will not reduce health below this value while a recognized mask, respirator, or cloth face covering is worn.
Legacy Toxic Max Health Damage
Legacy compatibility value. Prefer the per-minute toxic damage options below.
Toxic Tick Seconds
Seconds between each toxic damage/exposure server tick.
Use legacy event audio
Restores the original sounds and event sequences. Disabled: 30-second Rotor-Chop warning, then event audio alongside a continuous rotor. New events always use the new audio.
Use Vanilla Rotor In HTT Events
Applies only to legacy audio. New audio always uses Rotor-Chop.
Vanilla Hook Trigger Chance
Chance (0-100) that a vanilla helicopter trigger starts an HTT event.
